Follows Claude Code 2.1.310: image thumbnails and round bubble corners now draw inside tmux.

- Inside tmux 3.3 or later, desk-look asks tmux (as Claude Code does) for the terminal outside it and the pane's `allow-passthrough` and `focus-events`; attached from kitty 0.28 or later, Ghostty, or iTerm2 3.5 or later with both on, pasted image thumbnails and round corners of multi-line prompt bubbles are drawn instead of glyphs
- Inside tmux the thumbnail is sent as PNG bytes (Claude Code passes only bytes through tmux), so a pasted image over 2 MiB stays as `[Image #N]` there
- To turn it on: `tmux set -g allow-passthrough on` and `tmux set -g focus-events on`, detach and attach again, then restart Claude Code

Needs Claude Code 2.1.310 or later.

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
